briefdescription.para: Match any valid SDValue.
Similar to m_Specific, but the specific value to match is determined by another sub-pattern in the same sd_match() expression.

detaileddescription.para: For instance, We cannot match (add V, V) with m_Add(m_Value(X), m_Specific(X)) since X is not initialized at the time it got copied into m_Specific. Instead, we should use m_Add(m_Value(X), m_Deferred(X)).
